verdict.rationale: Clara documents creating virtual cards that are active immediately. It also supports merchant category restrictions, per-card limits with reset periodicity, and lock/delete, so a finance lead can issue a separate restricted card per subscription. However, the restriction is by merchant category, not locked to a single named vendor. Nothing frames this as single-vendor or SaaS-subscription cards. Missing for 10: true single-merchant locking, a documented per-vendor or subscription card workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can create single-vendor virtual cards for SaaS subscriptions and procurement so one compromised vendor never exposes shared credit

citations.quote: `"VIRTUAL"` creates a virtual card, active immediately (no activation step needed).
Use the Card Configurations API to add time, day-of-week, or merchant category restrictions.
Create, update, lock/unlock, and delete cards.
`periodicity`: `"MONTHLY"`, `"WEEKLY"`, or `"DAILY"` — determines when the limit resets
